picks.name: Conducta
picks.source_note: New artist/label discovery -- Up Ya Archives is Nia Archives' label. Another dry research day; this is a genuine new-to-the-pool discovery, about four and a half months old rather than brand new, disclosed per usual practice. Exact release-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link points to the label's confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "SOUNDBOY JOHNNY" (June 16, 2026, Up Ya Archives) is Conducta's first full project for Nia Archives' label -- a three-track EP ("Low Can U Go" feat. Blvk H3ro, "Soundboy Johnny," "In Your Arms") that pushes the UK garage producer into breakbeat and jungle territory, cranking up the BPM and toughening the low-end.
picks.why_listen: A respected UKG producer stepping into jungle/breaks -- tougher, faster material than his usual output, good for a shift into higher-energy territory.
